product.description: Crime, războaie și trădări, minciuni și senzualitate, prăbușirea unei mari dinastii și intrigile politice care au influențat decisiv istoria Franței. Carol al IV-lea tocmai a murit, iar odată cu dispariția lui dinastia capețianăse stinge, implinind astfel blestemul templierilor. Deschizacirc;ndu-i caleaspre tron vărului său Filip, din dinastia de Valois, Robert drsquo;Artois se așteaptăsă primească in schimb pămacirc;nturile familiei sale, pentru care nu s-a dat inlături nici de la realizarea de falsuri, nici de la sperjur sau crimă. Dar trădărilesunt departe de a se fi terminat, iar contele Robert este nevoit să fugădin țară și să ceară adăpost in Anglia. Săbiile se ascut iar, leul se trezește,și un nou pretendent la tron amenință incă o dată Franța... "Sălbatic, senzual, plin de viață, bogat documentat..., printre cele mai buneromane istorice." (The Times Literary Supplement) "Regii blestemați are de toate: regi de fier și regine sugrumate, războaie șitrădări, minciuni și senzualitate, inșelătorii, rivalități de familie, blestemulcavalerilor templieri, bebeluși schimbați la naștere, femei-lup, prăbușireaunei mari dinastii, iar toate acestea (sau mare parte din ele) sunt luate directdin paginile de istorie. și, credeți-mă, familiile Stark și Lannister nu sunt maiinteresante decacirc;t Capețienii și Plantageneții. Fie că ești pasionat de istoriesau de literatura fantasy, nu vei putea lăsa din macirc;nă romanele lui Druon:este Urzeala tronurilor in original." (George R.R. Martin)

# The Cursed Kings: The Lion and the Mane (Volume 6) by Litera

Dive into a sweeping saga of royal ambition, political betrayal, and enduring destiny with *The Cursed Kings*. This highly anticipated sixth volume continues the epic journey through the turbulent history of French royalty. If you are looking for immersive historical fantasy that rivals the scope of legend, your search ends here.

***

## A Dynasty Under Siege: Royal Intrigue and Betrayal

*The Lion and the Mane* plunges readers into a period defined by bloodshed and devastating secrets. The fragile peace following the death of Charles IV has shattered the Capetian dynasty, unleashing a torrent of political machinations that have historically shaped France. As power struggles intensify, Robert Artois schemes for his family's inheritance, navigating a world where treason is commonplace and lies are currency.

The conflict sends Robert into exile in England, but the betrayals are far from over. With swords drawn once more, the threat remains: a new claimant to the throne looms, ready to challenge Franceâs stability. This novel masterfully blends genuine historical eventsâfrom the fall of great houses to Templar cursesâwith high-stakes fantasy action and sensual romance.

## Why Readers Are Calling It an Epic Masterpiece

The depth and scope of *The Cursed Kings* have earned glowing praise from critics who compare its quality to the greatest works of speculative fiction. The narrative is rich with complex characters, powerful emotions, and dizzying political maneuvering.

As noted by publications like *The Times Literary Supplement*, it offers a blend that is "wild, sensual, full of life, and richly documented... among the best historical romances." Even George R.R. Martin has weighed in, comparing the drama to the intensity of epic fantasy: "If you are passionate about history or fantasy literature, you will not be able to leave Druon's novels... It is Game of Thrones in original form."

This volume promises a thrilling mix of elements including:
*   High-stakes royal struggles and shifting allegiances.
*   The enduring curse of the Templars.
*   Intrigue involving powerful female characters and complex family rivalries.
*   A sweeping historical canvas set against dramatic, dangerous romances.

## Product Details & Ordering Information

**Book Title:** The Cursed Kings: The Lion and the Mane (Vol. 6)

**Category:** Historical Fantasy / Literature

Experience the ultimate blend of deep history and gripping fantasy storytelling today. Explore our collection of epic literature at [litera.ro](https://event.2performant.com/events/click?ad_type=product_store&unique=5155dfd4e&aff_code=bf1d69700&campaign_unique=0a8a2c4d9).

***

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Is this book purely historical fiction?**
A: No. While the novel is deeply rooted in real French history and political events, it incorporates strong elements of high fantasy, including curses and legendary conflict, making it a blend of historical and speculative fiction.

**Q: Does this volume require reading previous books?**
A: Yes. This book is Volume 6 in *The Cursed Kings* series and continues the story of the royal house, so readers should familiarize themselves with the preceding volumes for the full context of the characters and political machinations.

***
